title: Gaussian-kernel cluster analysis
subtitle: A per-cluster length scale from a histogram median, then potential depth, curvature, escape probability, superposition, interference and entanglement as field metrics over an embedding cluster.

stats.label: bins in the shared-memory histogram that finds the median distance
resolution of that median, held in 10 KB of shared memory
members, the most the CPU spectral metrics will report on

lede: One family of my cluster metrics treats a cluster of embeddings as a field rather than a point set. Each member contributes a Gaussian kernel of its distance, the width of the kernel is a per-cluster length scale, and the shape of the resulting potential describes the cluster. The family runs in the Inference Fabric's CUDA engine and is told in Physics as a lens on embeddings. The length scale is a constant times the median pairwise distance of the cluster, clamped to a documented range. A per-cluster scale makes the metrics independent of the embedding model's units.
quote: I left three metrics off the GPU until they can run without a hidden cap.
evidence: Embedding analytics and cluster metrics: Gaussian-kernel field metrics per cluster (potential depth, curvature, escape probability, superposition, interference, entanglement) on a per-cluster length scale.
CUDA kernel development: the median pairwise distance read from a 256-bin shared-memory histogram at 0.4% resolution in 10 KB, and entanglement tiled over the upper triangle with no Gram matrix.
Bounded numerical methods: three Gram-matrix spectral metrics kept as CPU reference code that reports nothing above 2,000 members instead of sampling.
author: Corey James
